description: This file defines a function that constructs and returns a configuration object adhering to the 'CliBackendPlugin' interface, customized for an OpenAI Codex CLI backend. It imports types and defaults from external SDK modules and specifies command-line arguments, input/output formats, session management, watchdog settings, and serialization options.
